title: Hockey-puck devices on the shins

tellings.quote: And then they came for me. I was terrified. He kind of like reached up in the air with his long thin articulated arms [music] and he had this thing in his hand that looked like a flattened hockey puck and they put one on on the outside of each one of my shins and then I couldn't move my legs.

as_told.title: Puck-shaped discs on Jim's shins paralyze his legs

plain: Jim Weiner, one of a group of men who say they were taken aboard a craft while camping near Allagash, Maine, in 1976, tells Michels that when the beings came for him he was terrified. He says one of them reached up with long, thin, jointed arms holding something like a flattened hockey puck, and that they put one on the outside of each of his shins, after which he could not move his legs. He tells it as something done to him, and he tells it twice in nearly the same words.
